gaps.lead: She got up early so that she wouldn't miss the train.
gaps.sentence: She got up early ___ the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive express negative purpose.

gaps.lead: Everybody says he is the best dentist in town.
gaps.sentence: He ___ the best dentist in town.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally believed to be.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: They say this forest is three hundred years old.
gaps.sentence: This forest ___ three hundred years old.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said/believed to be.

gaps.lead: Someone should test this water regularly.
gaps.explanation: should test → should be tested (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to begin.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing/noun: looking forward to the holidays beginning.
